title: A finite-time serialization machine
statement: Let $F$ be a code format whose table-skipping function is primitive recursive. There exist a finite Turing machine $M$ and a time bound $T\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that, on every bit string $x$, $M$ halts within $T(|x|)$ steps and outputs the serialization of the code obtained by decoding $x$.
hypotheses_covered: The table-skipping function of $F$ is primitive recursive
